title: Brainarea Test Definition v1
description: One test (screening, personality, ability) as declarative data. The static engine renders any test purely from this file; adding a test never means touching engine code. Language rules: languages[] lists codes with COMPLETE content (order = fallback order); per-language display strings for dimension labels live in i18n keyed by dimension id; item text is inline per item (likert/order) or per variant (ability).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this document conforms to.

id.description: Unique, language-neutral test id. Used in URLs, sharing payloads, analytics keys.

family.description: Catalog track. v1 tracks: persona (personality), evner (ability/IQ), relations (relationship), pool (shared item pools).

languages.description: Language codes with complete content for this test. Engine picks best match for user language, falls back to first entry.

scoring.description: Scoring configuration, discriminated by scoring.type. trait=personality scales (continuous, percentile vs norms). threshold=screening bands with referral guidance (ADHD/autism/triage). g-score=ability tests (IQ-style metric, mean 100 SD 15, CI mandatory).

dimensions.description: Dimension vocabulary. Every scale/trait/band id used in scoring and every scales[].id referenced by items MUST be declared here; engine validates the cross-reference at load time.

label.description: Primary label, anchored to labelLanguage; other languages resolve via i18n keyed by dimension id.

labelLanguage.description: BCP47-style tag of the primary label.

description.description: Short neutral description of what the dimension measures; shown on result pages.

items.description: Full item pool for this test. Engine samples per session (randomization/no-repeat design is engine config, not test data). Reverse-keyed items (scales[].sign=-1) must exist for every scale to limit acquiescence bias; coverage check is a load-time engine validation.

item.description: One question/task. Kind discriminates: likert (screening/personality), ability (parallel variants with per-variant answer key), order (sequence task, canonical order in data, shuffled at runtime). Engine load-time checks (beyond schema): correctIndex < len(options) per variant; every scale has >=1 reverse-keyed item (acquiescence); scale ids cross-referenced against dimensions; item/variant lang member of languages; option counts match across variants of same item; item ids unique per file; pool refs resolve.

id.description: Item id, unique within this file (engine enforces).

pool.description: Optional shared pool reference. If set, item content lives in /tests/pool/<pool>.<poolItem>.<lang>.json and this record carries only metadata/sampling hints; engine merges content at load time.

lang.description: Language code of inline content. Required for likert/order; must be one of test.languages (engine-validated).

text.description: Likert: question text. One sentence, second person, no double-barrelled phrasing (QC enforces).

options.description: Likert: response options (2-7) with raw values (1..7 typical). Anchor set count must match across languages for the same item.

reverse.description: Likert convenience flag: fully reverse-keyed item, equivalent to scales[].sign=-1 for all scales listed. Engine normalizes to the scales representation.

variants.description: Ability: parallel variants of the same construct and difficulty; exactly one language per variant; answer key is per variant because surface differs across languages.

correctIndex.description: Index into options of the correct answer. Schema enforces 0..7 (options maxItems 8); the REAL bound (correctIndex < len(options)) is an engine load-time check, listed above.

difficulty.description: IRT b (difficulty), placeholder value until calibration data exists. Normering replaces placeholders with measured values.

elements.description: Order: task elements in CORRECT canonical order; engine shuffles for presentation.

scales.description: Which dimensions this item contributes to, with sign. sign=1: agreement/correct answer indicates more of the scale; sign=-1: reverse-keyed (or use reverse flag on Likert).

norms.description: Norm status: none=raw scores only (honest display), collecting=endpoint data gathering in progress, published=norms table attached. Preplan forbids showing percentiles based on norms that do not exist.

normsFile.description: Path to norms table JSON. Required when norms=published.

minScore.description: Inclusive lower bound of the band in weighted raw score.

guidance.description: Required for top bands of screening tests: concrete next step (e.g. vurder utredning), never a diagnosis.

disclaimer.description: Fixed disclaimer id rendered verbatim on the result page. REQUIRED: every screening test declares which disclaimer it uses; engine refuses to render result pages without it.

metric.description: Ability scores reported as IQ-style metric, mean 100, SD 15.

ci95.description: Report 95 pct confidence interval. Mandatory for ability scores; retest-honesty requires CI display, not point estimate alone.

maxItems.description: Items offered per session from the pool (sampled without repeats across sessions until pool near-exhaustion).
